rubric.role_summary: Senior product design role leading a company-wide accessibility program, combining accessibility strategy and design-system work with hands-on visual and interaction design across product platforms.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior product design role leading a company-wide accessibility program, combining accessibility strategy and design-system work with hands-on visual and interaction design across product platforms.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Accessibility expertise paired with interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, and prototyping skills.
- Experience leading accessibility or inclusive-design work across multiple teams, products, or platforms.
- Practical knowledge of WCAG, assistive technologies, accessible interaction design, and platform-specific standards.
- Experience embedding accessibility into design systems, reusable components, and engineering workflows.
- Experience working directly with disabled people and applying their experiences to product and organizational decisions.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas. Relocation is offered; candidates outside these areas may qualify with explicit evidence of willingness to relocate. Current residence in the area is not mandatory.

soft_requirements: Understanding of the relationship between accessibility, usability, and inclusive design, including when to go beyond standards.
Ability to identify exclusion within product journeys and develop more flexible interactions.
Effectiveness in setting strategy, designing detailed experiences, and collaborating with engineers.
Ability to influence across disciplines without direct authority and create shared accountability.
